main_text.p: luntarij moderatores, qui sibi auctoritate à Deo non concessam sumunt.
2. Reuocant aut suos sectatores à Creatore ad Creaturas, præsertim uerò Spiri-tuales, quas neglecto Creatore colunt.
3. Delectantur autem superstitiosa τῆ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ & cultu.
4. Rhetoricantur de ijs quæ non uiderunt.
5. Sine ratione tument, δολομανίαν καὶ δοξοσοφίαν eorū carnis intelligentia pariente.
6. Caput non obtinent, quia Spiritu Christi destituuntur.
main_text.head: DE INCREMENTIS MYSTICI CORPORIS CHRISTI, verf. 19.
main_text.p: Καὶ ὁ ὑεχατῶν τῆς ὑεφαλῆς ἐξ ὧν τὸ σῶμα διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδεσμῶν ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον, αὔξει τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ Θεοῦ.
Negs obtinens caput, ex quo totum corpus per commissuras & compages suppeditatum & compactum, augescit Dei augmento.

page.notes:
Lectio 28, 8. Iulij. (Left margin note.)

Greek and Hebrew lines are transcribed as best legible; the Greek in the lower block and the superscript Greek in item 3 and 5 are uncertain. The last line "Non" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot right.
